group_1.narration: <Yuu carried on with her "job"@with no regard to Nagisa accompanying her.>

group_1.textCenter: (While Nagisa here is just sitting on the sidelines...)
This is a capital-S Serious situation.
(...You don't think they're gonna arrest me, too,@do you?)
(I don't wanna dig myself into any more trouble.)
(But...I'm in the middle of investigating Yuu.)
(Regardless of what this looks like, if she's killing@people indiscriminately...)
Either way, I'll just keep tabs on her@for the time being...

group_1.textRight: Whew... Sorry to keep you waiting~.

group_1.textLeft: ...All done?

group_1.textRight: Yeah.
Everything's gone now.

group_1.textLeft: ...That transformation's before and after difference@is as huge as ever...
Going from a monster back to a human.

group_1.textRight: [chara:390101:effect_emotion_surprise_0][se:7226_shock]A-a monster?! You don't mean me, do you?@Are you talking about me?

group_1.textLeft: ...Why do you react like you're hearing this@for the first time...
Every single time?

group_1.textRight: [chara:390101:effect_emotion_sad_0][se:7224_fall_into]H-how terrible! I'm in shock!
...[chara:390101:lipSynch_0][wait:0.8][chara:390101:lipSynch_1][chara:390101:cheek_0][chara:390101:face_mtn_ex_050.exp3.json]Er, unless I took it the wrong way?@Maybe you meant it as a compliment?

group_1.textLeft: I did not.

group_1.textRight: Oh. That's okay.

group_1.textLeft: (She genuinely does get sad and surprised,)
(but then she bounces right back to normal...)
(It's like she's going in circles...)
(...But setting that aside...)
By the way... There's something I've been meaning@to ask.

group_1.textRight: Whaaat?

group_1.textLeft: How long are you gonna stick with this job?

group_1.textRight: How long?
Until my list is empty, of course?

group_1.textLeft: Where does that list come from, anyway?

group_1.textRight: Shii writes it for me, you know?

group_1.textLeft: Shii?

group_1.textRight: Mm. She's the one writing this for me.

group_1.textLeft: (So this Shii guy is the one making Yuu kill people,@then?)
Let's say your list is wrong,
and it's full of good people instead of bad ones.
Would this still be a good thing?

group_1.textRight: Hmm... We make extra sure to only write down@the names of bad guys, so it should be fine?
...Although I guess nothing in this world is certain.
Is that what you're thinking?
Yeah, that's understandable, y'know?
But even then, no matter what kind of people@these bad guys are,
getting rid of them is still a positive thing for Shii.
So at least that part isn't wrong?

group_1.textLeft: What you're telling me is that,
even if you end up taking out an innocent good guy,
that'd still be a good thing for Shii,
so you're gonna keep working?

group_1.textRight: Yeah?

group_1.textLeft: ...Good grief...

group_1.narration: <Conversations between Yuu and Nagisa usually@go like this; rambling and disorganized.>
<However, by mustering the patience@to press onward, Nagisa was able@to gradually gather bits and pieces@of information about Yuu.>
